title: C03 batch plan
description: Many requests submitted together. Each item is its own sealed request, named by digest, and the carrier that commits it; the items one carrier commits are committed together or not at all, and items on different carriers are not. A retry submits the same plan, so every item keeps its request id and a committed one returns its original result rather than running again.

carrier.description: The carrier that commits: this installation's own store, a peer, a GitHub exchange repository, or a package.
